CHARACTER_SHOW.settings.allowPlayerLocal: Allow players to move portraits locally
When disabled, only the GM can move or resize portraits. Players can still move their own toolbar, minimize, and reset old local adjustments.
CHARACTER_SHOW.settings.syncOrganization: When disabled, the shared stage syncs only which actors are present and who is speaking. Movement, size, names, flipping, arrangement, and minimization stay local to each user.
CHARACTER_SHOW.settings.allowPlayerOwned: Allow players to mark owned actors as speaking
When enabled, players can mark only actors they own as speaking. When disabled, only the GM controls who is speaking.
CHARACTER_SHOW.settings.imageFraming.hin: Controls how actor artwork is displayed. Portrait keeps a cropped 4:5 frame for a uniform grid; natural keeps the image ratio with reasonable width limits.
CHARACTER_SHOW.settings.showControls.hin: Display the compact Character Show control bar.
